question: Which product categories have total revenue above Rs 20,000?

question: Which 5 customers have spent the most?
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS total_spent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_orders FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5
answer: The five customers who have spent the most are Vikram Nair (Rs 33,895), Ananya Iyer (Rs 28,796), Dev Chauhan (Rs 21,999), Pooja Desai (Rs 17,998) and Rohan Mehta (Rs 17,498). Only the first rows are shown.

question: What share of total revenue does each product category contribute?
sql: WITH non_cancelled AS (SELECT oi.*, o.status FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'), category_rev AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM non_cancelled AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total FROM category_rev), cancelled AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled') SELECT cr.category, cr.revenue, cr.revenue / tr.total AS share, c.cancelled_orders FROM category_rev AS cr CROSS JOIN total_rev AS tr CROSS JOIN cancelled AS c LIMIT 100
answer: Accessories contribute about 10.3 % of total revenue (Rs 18,834), Electronics about 45.6 % (Rs 83,674), Furniture about 41.1 % (Rs 75,392), and Stationery about 3.1 % (Rs 5,630).
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, 100.0 * SUM(i.unit_price * i.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(i2.unit_price * i2.quantity) FROM order_items i2 JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = i2.order_id WHERE o2.status != 'cancelled') FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category
